description: Shared correctness fixtures (docs/benchmark-correctness-fixtures.md). Three datasets, each a single input stream. Every variant applies a deterministic (never random) SEQUENCE of operation-type/value shifts at fixed indices — the variable under test is WHEN and HOW the JIT's speculative assumptions get violated over the course of one long run, never the final computed total, which is fixture-pinned per (variant, dataset) cell.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)
semantics.stableTypeProfile: every index uses typeA — no shift ever occurs
semantics.profileShiftAfterWarmup: i < shiftPoint: typeA; i >= shiftPoint: typeA if i is even else typeB — a second concrete type appears for the first time at shiftPoint
semantics.rareExceptionPath: every index uses typeA EXCEPT index rareExceptionIndex, which contributes fallbackException instead (a caught, deterministic exception)
semantics.lateSubtypeLoading: i < shiftPoint: typeA; i >= shiftPoint: typeC — a third concrete type, never before constructed, is used starting at shiftPoint
semantics.nullabilityShift: i < shiftPoint: typeA, never null; i >= shiftPoint: typeA EXCEPT where (i - shiftPoint) mod nullStride == 0, which contributes fallbackNull instead (a null-marker input)
